publishedRecipe.name: Apricot Chicken Salad with Spinach & Crusty Bread

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in a small saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove from liquid and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
In a large bowl, prepare dressing by mixing together yogurt, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add almonds and, stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry celery and green onions. Small dice celery and add to bowl with dressing. Trim and discard root ends, chop onions, and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 sticks celery
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Small dice apricots and add to bowl. Add almonds to bowl.
Pat dry the chicken with paper towels, small dice, and add to bowl. Toss salad until well combined.
To serve, arrange a bed of spinach on a plate and top with chicken salad. Enjoy with crusty bread!
